[[Image:Seanchan-icon.svg|right|125px]]
A '''Truthspeaker''' or '''''Soe'feia''''' is a ''[[so'jhin]]'' who serves [[Seanchan]] royalty by telling them the absolute truth of a situation as they see it, no matter how painful or humiliating it might be. While many of [[the Blood]] call their Voice "Truthspeaker," few understand how much power they truly hold. Since those owned by the Blood are ''so'jhin'' they can be punished, but a true Truthspeaker is required to tell the absolute truth and may not be punished for it. Many think that [[Algwyn]], the last man to hold the [[Crystal Throne]], was mad to allow his ''soe'feia'' to live after she slapped him in the face before the entire court.{{ref/book|9|14}}
